Keep the gated product private. Continue bounded read-only rights, data-flow, retention, consent, vendor, accuracy, attribution, and security evidence work. Keep permission outreach unsent pending owner and human-counsel authorization.

Continue authorized read-only evidence capture for access boundaries, secrets, runtime isolation, release controls, dependencies, monitoring, incidents, TLS, and disclosure readiness. Missing evidence remains unknown and does not authorize security-sensitive public exposure or production mutation.
